lines: Every person alive is missing one second of their life. He took it.
In a city of clocks, a clockmaker's daughter was dying.
Papa... will I see the spring?
So he built a clock that could steal time. Just one second... from every person on Earth.
Eight billion seconds. That's two hundred and fifty years of life.
She saw every spring after that.
But a thief always pays. Since 1972, the world's clocks have added twenty-seven extra seconds.
Scientists call them leap seconds. Some say... he's paying it back.
